Valheim Save File Location (Windows, macOS & Linux)

Valheim stores its save files at %USERPROFILE%\AppData\LocalLow\IronGate\Valheim\worlds_local on Windows. Checkpoint64 already knows this folder — it backs it up automatically and keeps every version, so a corrupted or overwritten save is one click from restored.

Where Valheim saves are stored

  • Windows — %USERPROFILE%\AppData\LocalLow\IronGate\Valheim\worlds_local
  • macOS — ~/Library/Application Support/IronGate/Valheim/worlds_local
  • Linux — ~/.config/unity3d/IronGate/Valheim/worlds_local

The save data here is .db / .fwl / .old files — back up the folder as a set, not single files, so a restore always keeps them consistent.

How to open the save folder

  • Windows — press Win+R, paste %USERPROFILE%\AppData\LocalLow\IronGate\Valheim\worlds_local, and press Enter (the AppData folder is hidden in Explorer, which is why this path is so easy to miss — pasting it skips the hunt).
  • macOS — in Finder press Cmd+Shift+G (Go to Folder) and paste ~/Library/Application Support/IronGate/Valheim/worlds_local.

Backing up Valheim saves automatically

  1. Install Checkpoint64 (free) and pick Valheim — the save path above is already preset.
  2. Auto-backup watches the folder and uploads a new version whenever it changes, keeping full history.
  3. Restore any version in one click if a save corrupts, gets overwritten, or a mod breaks it.
